mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both unemployment rate and job growth indicate a labor market cooling too rapidly, triggering recession fears and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both UNRATE and PAYEMS decline for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by strong consumer spending, rising retail sales above the 3-month moving average predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy avoids recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 3-month moving average during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past 3 months signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to strong manufacturing data.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, when the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and is rising, it compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a potential recession.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
